description:
An X profile plus its recent timeline (up to 60 tweets incl. pinned, retweets and own replies) with text, media and engagement counts.
Cost: 2 credits per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: user_id (string, nullable), username (string), full_name (string), biography (string), location (string), external_url (string, nullable), is_private (boolean), is_verified (boolean), is_blue_verified (boolean), follower_count (integer, nullable), following_count (integer, nullable), tweet_count (integer, nullable), like_count (integer, nullable), media_count (integer, nullable), listed_count (integer, nullable), created_at (string, nullable), profile_image_url (string, nullable), profile_banner_url (string, nullable), posts (array<object>), posts_fetched (integer), has_more (boolean).

limit.description: Maximum number of tweets to return. Example: 20

username.description: X username, @handle or profile URL. Example: "tesla"

name: x_posts
title: X posts
